This '''mission''' was performed by the [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] with the purpose of freeing [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminals from [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].

The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] wanted to insert Black Sun criminals in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After much debate they decided to get those criminals from Kessel. So that they would not arouse suspicion, the New Republic decided to also take people who would be useful to the New Republic. They intended to get seventeen criminals and to negotiate with the head of Kessel to take some criminals off his hands if he would let them take some good people. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was then sent to Kessel with New Republic operatives to complete the mission. After a flyby done by the majority of Rogue Squadron to disable Kessel's defenses, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] landed on Kessel to negotiate. They only got sixteen criminals.
